measurement_kind: composition only (dsh --dump-config): proves the row is ABSENT, never a plugin load
claim: A clean install of ONLY the bundle composes NO dsh-better-sidebar row, so the betterSidebar service never exists and the bundle's two sidebar-only pages register nothing (the reported 'sidebar cannot display').
how_to_reproduce: write profiles/web/package.json with dsh.profile.bundles = [dsh-base, dsh-web-app, @mpd-dsh/mpd] and dependencies {'@mpd-dsh/mpd':'link:<repo>'}
write profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml = packages ['.'] / nodeLinker: hoisted / autoInstallPeers: false
DSH_HOME=$SB/dsh HOME=$SB/home dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -c better-sidebar  => 0
note: The `dsh plugin --profile web add .` path cannot be exercised in this environment: pnpm's store index (outside the workspace) is unwritable under the workspace-write sandbox, so pnpm exits with ERR_SQLITE_ERROR. The hand-built profile is byte-equivalent for the row-composition question, and the repo's own QA cases (preset-conformance.mjs, settings-bridge-lane.mjs) build their sandbox profiles the same way.
